description: Call a Canvas REST API endpoint directly, for anything the other tools don't cover. Requests only go to your Canvas, inside /api/v1. GET is read-only. POST, PUT and DELETE can change data: they are blocked when CANVAS_ALLOW_WRITES=false and need confirmation. Quiz-submission writes and endpoints that hand out sign-ins or tokens are always refused. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

max_items.description: With paginate=true, stop after this many items. Default 200.

paginate.description: Follow Link headers and collect all pages (GET only)
